title: The classes of failure to which each rule belongs

verses.t: When it comes to the offenses that are a result of consenting to physical contact, to how many of the four kinds of failure do they belong? They belong to two kinds of failure: they may be failure in morality; they may be failure in conduct. …
When it comes to the offenses that are a result of asking for curd and then eating it, to how many of the four kinds of failure do they belong? They belong to one kind of failure: failure in conduct.
The classes of failure to which each rule belongs, the third, are finished.
